hooks.name: Re-run verification on logic.py or mapping.yaml save
hooks.description: Runs the verifier against the Referee when a migration's generated logic.py or mapping.yaml is saved.

action.command: python3 -c "import sys,json,re,subprocess; d=sys.stdin.read(); m=re.search(r'(\.kiro/specs/[^/\"]+)/(?:logic\.py|mapping\.yaml)', d); sys.exit(0) if not m else sys.exit(subprocess.call(['python3','-m','ghost.cli','verify',m.group(1)]))"
